claims: The Artemis 2 launch is targeted for April 1, 2026.
The Artemis 2 launch can be viewed live on NASA+ beginning around 7:45 a.m. EDT.
The Artemis 2 launch can be viewed live on NASA’s YouTube channel beginning around 7:45 a.m. EDT.
The Artemis 2 launch can be viewed live on Amazon Prime Video beginning around 7:45 a.m. EDT.
NASA+ and YouTube provide continuous coverage of the Artemis 2 launch starting with tanking operations at 7:45 a.m. EDT.
NASA+ and YouTube provide more curated, shorter coverage of the Artemis 2 launch starting at 12:50 p.m. EDT.
The NASA App allows streaming of the Artemis 2 launch directly on iOS, Android, Roku, and Fire TV.
Amazon Prime Video provides live coverage of the Artemis 2 launch under the Prime "Live TV" section.
In-person viewing of the Artemis 2 launch is available on Florida's Space Coast.
Official watch parties for the Artemis 2 launch are held at Space Center Houston.
Space View Park, Parrish Park, and Sand Point Park are popular spots for in-person viewing in Titusville on Florida's Space Coast.
Jetty Park Pier, Alan Shepard Park, and Lori Wilson Park are in-person viewing spots in Cocoa Beach/Cape Canaveral on Florida's Space Coast.
Kennedy Space Center Visitor Complex requires specific pre-purchased launch viewing packages.
